Voice of Vietnam FAQ

What frequency is Voice of Vietnam on?
In the A-26 season Voice of Vietnam is scheduled on 8 shortwave frequencies, including 7220, 7221, 7285, 9730, 9835, 9840 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9840 kHz (7:30 pm – 8 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9730 kHz (8 pm – 8:30 pm UTC+1).

Can I hear Voice of Vietnam in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 9840 kHz (7:30 pm – 8 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does Voice of Vietnam broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 7220 kHz at 16:00–16:30 UTC to Middle East; 7220 kHz at 20:30–21:00 UTC to Middle East; 9730 kHz at 16:00–16:30 UTC to Europe; 9730 kHz at 19:00–19:30 UTC to Europe; 9730 kHz at 21:30–22:00 UTC to Europe; plus 14 more.

Is Voice of Vietnam on the air right now?
As of Saturday, September 26, 2026, 09:51 UTC, Voice of Vietnam is not currently scheduled to be broadcasting. Next scheduled transmission is 9840 kHz at 10:00 UTC. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
